properties.title: Underwater Cable
properties.body:
EASTERN NORTH ATLANTIC.
BAY OF CADIZ.
1. SEISMIC SURVEY IN PROGRESS UNTIL 04 MAR
   BY M/V POLARCUS NAILA TOWING TEN 8000 METER
   LONG CABLES IN AREA BETWEEN
   36-14.9N 36-44.9N AND 007-45.1W 009-00.1W.
   WIDE BERTH REQUESTED.
2. CANCEL THIS MSG 05 MAR.
